snippet.title: Ironwing Valiant - November Combat Playtest (Check Description)
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, we are holding a combat playtest for the new build and features for Ironwing Valiant that takes palce next week. If you would like to sign up, please join our Discord and ping KungFu Tiger, I will get your sorted with a key next week.
Discord Link: https://discord.gg/ee85CMBpMq

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871670/Ironwing_Valiant_Record_of_Astera/

Twitter: https://x.com/Tiger_TeamGames
